editorial:
Imagine being a brand new cop and deciding that the best way to start your career is by going undercover to bait a serial killer. That is exactly what Linda Murphy does in this gripping crime drama. You get to follow her journey as she pushes past the doubts of her boss and teams up with an FBI agent to protect vulnerable women. The vibe is very much like those late-night crime shows you can't stop watching, blending a sense of danger with the grit of a real-life police investigation.

What really makes this work is the acting, especially Sarah Drew, who makes you truly root for her. The pacing is steady, though some parts feel a bit like a typical TV movie. If you love mysteries where a determined lead proves everyone wrong, you will dig this. It is best experienced streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture quality, but you can also rent it on Apple TV if that is easier. For those who love owning their movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this thriller handy.
endingExplained: After a lot of danger, Linda successfully lures the killer into a trap. Using her undercover identity, she manages to get close enough to identify him and coordinate a bust with her team. The killer is finally arrested, proving that Linda's risky plan was the only way to stop the murders. The movie wraps up with her gaining the respect of her colleagues and showing that her instincts were right all along.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true crime stories and strong female leads.
